cards.example_en: The trainee watched carefully as the chef chopped vegetables.
cards.example_zh: 厨师切菜时，那名实习生在一旁仔细观察。
cards.explain_zh: trainee接受培训；trainer负责培训他人。

cards.example_en: She offered me a piece of mint gum.
cards.example_zh: 她给了我一片薄荷口香糖。
cards.explain_zh: 口香糖不可数；牙龈通常用复数gums。

cards.example_en: Regular dental checkups can help detect gum disease before it causes serious damage.
cards.example_zh: 定期进行牙科检查有助于在牙龈疾病造成严重损害前发现问题。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She put a soft cushion behind her back.
cards.example_zh: 她在背后放了一个柔软的靠垫。
cards.explain_zh: 动词常搭配impact或blow，表示减轻冲击。

cards.example_en: She put a soft cushion behind her back.
cards.example_zh: 她在背后放了一个柔软的靠垫。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
cards.example_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
cards.explain_zh: 比喻人或机构落伍时带贬义，正式交流慎用。

cards.example_en: Studying dinosaur fossils helps researchers understand how ancient environments differed from those of the present day.
cards.example_zh: 研究恐龙化石有助于科研人员了解古代环境与当今环境的差异。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Bring a light jacket, but heavy boots are unnecessary.
cards.example_zh: 带一件薄外套吧，但厚靴子就没必要了。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“没必要做”可用 it is unnecessary to do。

cards.example_en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
cards.example_zh: 请别告诉你姐姐，免得破坏这份惊喜。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均可用spoiled或spoilt。

cards.example_en: Please don't spoil the surprise by telling your sister.
cards.example_zh: 请别告诉你姐姐，免得破坏这份惊喜。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My sister sings in the choir every Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐每周日都在唱诗班唱歌。
cards.explain_zh: 发音近似quire，开头不是常见的/ch/音。

cards.example_en: We usually eat leftover turkey together on Boxing Day.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常在节礼日一起吃剩下的火鸡肉。
cards.explain_zh: 固定指12月26日；首字母大写，不加连字符。

cards.example_en: We usually eat leftover turkey together on Boxing Day.
cards.example_zh: 我们通常在节礼日一起吃剩下的火鸡肉。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
cards.example_zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。
cards.explain_zh: fog比mist更浓；fog up常指玻璃蒙上雾气。

cards.example_en: Thick fog hid the hills behind our house.
cards.example_zh: 浓雾遮住了我们屋后的山丘。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We were permitted to feed the goats at noon.
cards.example_zh: 我们获准在中午给山羊喂食。
cards.explain_zh: permit过去式双写t；被动式后接to do。

cards.example_en: A spotted dog was sleeping beside the garden gate.
cards.example_zh: 一只带斑点的狗正睡在花园门旁。
cards.explain_zh: 也可作spot的过去式或过去分词，意为发现。

cards.example_en: We left flowers beside the monument in the town square.
cards.example_zh: 我们把鲜花放在镇广场的纪念碑旁。
cards.explain_zh: 纪念某人或某事用a monument to。

cards.example_en: On Sundays they grill fish and corn in the small backyard.
cards.example_zh: 每到星期天，他们就在小后院烤鱼和玉米。
cards.explain_zh: 英式grill常指从上方加热；美式常指从下方烤。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: Rising grocery prices place considerable pressure on households that already spend most of their income on essentials.
cards.example_zh: 食品杂货价格上涨给那些已将大部分收入用于必需品的家庭带来了巨大压力。
cards.explain_zh: 食品杂货用复数groceries；作定语用grocery。

cards.example_en: Interactive museum exhibits can amuse young visitors while helping them understand complex scientific ideas.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆的互动展品既能让小游客玩得开心，也能帮助他们理解复杂的科学概念。
cards.explain_zh: amused形容人的感受；amusing形容有趣的事物。

cards.example_en: I left my trainers in a locker at the gym.
cards.example_zh: 我把运动鞋留在健身房的储物柜里了。
cards.explain_zh: locker通常是存放个人物品的小柜，不指上锁的人。

cards.example_en: The band's new song became a worldwide hit.
cards.example_zh: 这个乐队的新歌在全球大受欢迎。
cards.explain_zh: 既可作形容词，也可作副词：sell worldwide。

cards.example_en: Have you been sleeping well lately, or feeling tired?
cards.example_zh: 你最近睡得好吗，还是觉得疲倦？
cards.explain_zh: 常与现在完成时连用；不要与表示迟到的late混淆。

cards.example_en: I used a mop to clean the muddy kitchen floor.
cards.example_zh: 我用拖把擦洗了沾满泥的厨房地板。
cards.explain_zh: 动词过去式mopped，进行式mopping，均双写p。

cards.example_en: The baby-sitter read our daughter a story before bed.
cards.example_zh: 临时保姆在睡前给我们女儿读了一个故事。
cards.explain_zh: 现代更常写babysitter；通常指临时照看孩子的人。

cards.example_en: Hiring a reliable baby-sitter can help parents balance occasional evening work with their family responsibilities.
cards.example_zh: 雇用可靠的临时保姆，可以帮助父母兼顾偶尔的晚间工作和家庭责任。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: She wore a striped shirt and dark blue jeans.
cards.example_zh: 她穿着一件条纹衬衫和深蓝色牛仔裤。
cards.explain_zh: striped意为有条纹的；strip的过去式是stripped。

cards.example_en: She wore a striped shirt and dark blue jeans.
cards.example_zh: 她穿着一件条纹衬衫和深蓝色牛仔裤。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: One loose brick fell out of the garden wall.
cards.example_zh: 花园围墙上掉下了一块松动的砖。
cards.explain_zh: 单块砖可数；作建筑材料统称时可不可数。

cards.example_en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
cards.example_zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。
cards.explain_zh: 常用a souvenir of表示某次旅行或活动的纪念品。

cards.example_en: We bought a small wooden boat as a souvenir.
cards.example_zh: 我们买了一只小木船作为纪念品。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her childhood ambition was to design bridges across rivers.
cards.example_zh: 她儿时的志向是设计跨河大桥。
cards.explain_zh: 具体志向可数，进取心不可数；常接to do。

cards.example_en: This advanced camera takes clear pictures even at night.
cards.example_zh: 这台先进的相机即使在夜间也能拍出清晰的照片。
cards.explain_zh: advanced表示先进或高级；预先通知用advance notice。

cards.example_en: One earphone fell out while I was jogging.
cards.example_zh: 我慢跑时，一只耳机掉了出来。
cards.explain_zh: 通常用复数earphones；一副耳机用a pair of。

cards.example_en: Some garden plants contain poison, so keep pets away.
cards.example_zh: 有些园艺植物含有毒素，因此要让宠物远离。
cards.explain_zh: poison 是名词或动词；“有毒的”用 poisonous。

cards.example_en: Some garden plants contain poison, so keep pets away.
cards.example_zh: 有些园艺植物含有毒素，因此要让宠物远离。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Buying a monthly pass gave me a useful saving.
cards.example_zh: 买月票让我省下了一笔实用的开支。
cards.explain_zh: 表示积蓄通常用复数savings；节省可用单数。

cards.example_en: Investing in efficient heating systems can produce significant energy savings for households over the long term.
cards.example_zh: 从长远来看，投资高效供暖系统能显著降低家庭能耗。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I used a torch to find my missing keys.
cards.example_zh: 我用手电筒寻找丢失的钥匙。
cards.explain_zh: 手电筒英式叫torch，美式叫flashlight。

cards.example_en: Hikers should carry a torch and spare batteries when exploring remote areas after sunset.
cards.example_zh: 徒步者在日落后探索偏远地区时，应携带手电筒和备用电池。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our cheerful neighbour waved as we left the house.
cards.example_zh: 我们出门时，开朗的邻居向我们挥了挥手。
cards.explain_zh: 既可形容人心情开朗，也可形容环境明快。

cards.example_en: Our teacher used a toy rabbit to explain each preposition.
cards.example_zh: 老师用一只玩具兔来解释每个介词。
cards.explain_zh: 介词后通常接名词、代词或动名词。

cards.example_en: I was terrified when thunder shook the windows last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚雷声震得窗户发抖时，我吓坏了。
cards.explain_zh: 人感到害怕用terrified；事物吓人用terrifying。

cards.example_en: Students who are terrified of public speaking may benefit from practising presentations in small, supportive groups.
cards.example_zh: 极度害怕公开演讲的学生，可以通过在互相支持的小组中练习展示而受益。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The earthquake made the cups rattle on our kitchen shelf.
cards.example_zh: 地震使厨房架子上的杯子碰得咯咯作响。
cards.explain_zh: 可数名词；表示发生地震可说an earthquake strikes。

cards.example_en: Strict building regulations can significantly reduce the risk of injury when an earthquake strikes a densely populated city.
cards.example_zh: 当地震袭击人口稠密的城市时，严格的建筑法规可以显著降低人员受伤的风险。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The train entered a dark tunnel beneath the hill.
cards.example_zh: 火车驶入了山下的一条漆黑隧道。
cards.explain_zh: 介词 through 常表示从隧道内部穿过。

cards.example_en: A narrow footpath leads from our village to the lake.
cards.example_zh: 一条狭窄的小径从我们村通向湖边。
cards.explain_zh: 常指供步行的小径，不一定紧邻公路。

cards.example_en: A narrow footpath leads from our village to the lake.
cards.example_zh: 一条狭窄的小径从我们村通向湖边。

word.example_en: We saw a huge dinosaur skeleton at the museum.
word.example_zh: 我们在博物馆看到了一具巨大的恐龙骨架。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Boxing Day sales can boost retail revenue, but they also raise concerns about unnecessary consumption.
word.example_zh: 节礼日促销能增加零售收入，但也引发了对不必要消费的担忧。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

word.example_en: Dense fog can disrupt transport networks, causing flight cancellations and increasing the risk of road accidents.
word.example_zh: 浓雾可能扰乱交通网络，导致航班取消，并增加道路事故的风险。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
